orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice U. C. Dhyani
orders.text:
CLCON No.568 of 2017 
U.C. Dhyani, J. 
 Mr. Vinay Kumar, Advocate for 
the petitioner. 
It is the submission of learned 
counsel for the contempt petitioner that 
there is willful and deliberate 
disobedience of the order passed by a 
coordinate Bench of this Court on 
08.12.2016 in WPSS No.741/2016 as 
well as the judgment & order dated 
04.9.2017 passed by the Division Bench 
of this Court in Special Appeal 
No.82/2017. 
Issue notice to the respondent no.2 
to show cause, either in person or 
through counsel within six weeks, as to 
why contempt proceedings be not 
initiated against him for willful 
disobedience of court’s orders dated 
08.12.2016 & 04.9.2017? 
Steps be taken within a week.
(U.C. Dhyani, J.) 
 04.1.2018 A.kaur

orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Sharad Kumar Sharma
orders.text:
MCC No. 1364/2018 (Recall Application) 
IA No. 10539/2018 (Urgency Application) 
In 
CLCON No. 568 of 2017 
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Vinay Kumar, Advocate for the 
applicant. 
Mr. H.M. Raturi, Deputy Advocate 
General for the State of Uttarakhand. 
The present Contempt Petition is listed 
on number of applications. The first 
application, which is listed today is recall 
application being MCC No. 1364/2018, 
whereby, the applicant has sought recall of the 
order dated 13.09.2018 passed by the 
Coordinate Bench of this Court, by virtue of 
which the Contempt Petition has been disposed 
of. 
The reason for recall as pleaded in the 
application is that the manner in which the 
disposal of the Contempt Petition was made it 
deserved to be decided on merits. 
Considering the grounds taken in the 
recall application, as well as, the reason 
assigned in the recall application filed in 
Contempt Petition No. 567 of 2017, and the 
order passed on it today this Court is satisfied 
that the Contempt Petition requires a 
consideration on its merit. Hence, recall 
application is allowed. The order dated 
13.09.2018 is recalled and the Contempt 
Petition is restored to its original number. 
Urgency Application listed today would 
too stands disposed of with the direction that 
this Contempt Petition may be listed along with 
WPSS No. 182/2018 in the second week of 
January, 2019. 
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.) 
 06.12.2018 
Pooja

COURT’S OR JUDGE’S ORDERS
CLCON No. 568 of 2017
Shri Sanjaya Kumar Mishra, J.
Mr. Vinay Kumar, learned counsel for the 
petitioners.
Mr. M. C. Pandey, learned Additional Advocate 
General with Mr. T. S. Phartiyal, learned Deputy 
Advocate General for the respondents.
In the connected contempt application, the 
impleadment/amendment application has already been 
allowed.
The learned counsel for the petitioners submits 
that they could not file the impleadment application 
because of some unavoidable reasons. The Court 
exercises its power suo-moto and directs that the 
applicants namely “Mr. Ravi Nath Raman, Principal 
Secretary (Education), District Dehradun and
Vandana Garbiyal, Director Elementary 
Education, Directorate of Education Uttarakhand 
Dehradun District- Dehradun” shall be impleaded 
as respondent nos. 3 and 4 and the original 
incumbent shall continue to remain party to the 
contempt application. 
The petitioner is directed to file requisites and 
amended cause title page of the contempt petition 
within seven days. 
Thereafter, notice be issued to the newly 
added respondents/contemnors through registered 
post/speed post, acknowledgement due, returnable 
within four weeks. 
List this matter on 12.01.2023. 
(Sanjaya Kumar Mishra, J.)
 10.11.2022
